messages:
mina: Flagging a small but consistent regression after q5f8 conversion on mixed zh-fr samples: angle quotes (« ») are turning into ASCII guillemets or regular quotes and BLEU on a punct-heavy slice drops ~1.7.

chen: example?

mina: repro:
```
input (zh): 他说：「今晚我们去看电影。」
baseline (fp16): «Ce soir, on va au cinéma.»
q5f8: "Ce soir, on va au cinéma."
```
We used zh->fr test set where fullwidth CJK corner brackets map to French guillemets; now they become ASCII quotes. Also spacing around guillemets differs.

oscar: Is it tokenizer id remap or a softmax crossover after quant conversion? Any token-prob diffs?

mina: I dumped topk for the bracket tokens. fp16 top = U+00AB (guillemet left) p=0.37; q5f8 top = U+0022 p=0.372. Delta ~0.002-0.005 in many contexts.

yana: That's tiny but can flip deterministic detok steps. Can we add an eval slice focused on bracket/quote punctuation across zh, ja, fr, es? Call it "angle_brackets".

mina: Added slice to harness. Quick numbers: fp16 pre-detok BLEU=88.6, q5f8 pre-detok BLEU=86.9 (delta 1.7). post-detok delta 1.1. swap_rate (guillemet->ascii) = 0.42% (31/7400 contexts).

ops-bot: canary-deploy orion-q5f8 -> canary started (2 nodes) at 2026-03-21T16:12Z :rocket:

oscar: Could be per-group scale rounding similar to other punctuation regressions. Plan: run numeric-accumulation test and try converter flag to keep high-precision for punctuation token logits.

chen: For gating propose: fail canary if angle_brackets delta >1.0 BLEU AND swap_rate >0.4%. That would block this rollout.

mina: Running token-swap script on canary now and will post exact contexts. If converter tweak helps we can land it quickly; fallback is route pin to fp16 for affected locales.

yana: Also update downstream detok rules to be resilient: prefer unicode-aware mapping priorities when target language expects guillemets.

mina: Action items: 1) mina post canary token-swap log. 2) oscar run numeric-accum + converter tweak. 3) chen update gating rule and notify release. 4) yana add detok fallback. I'll update thread with canary stats when available.

chen: thanks, keep updates here.
